copy.masthead: Every club on one page, each number on its own scale and linked to the module that owns it.
copy.root_sentence: A weighted rank re-standardised across 30 clubs, not a forecast. Thirty percent of the index rests on a provisional projection (team_win_projections).
copy.weights_note: ROSTER and OUTLOOK overlap by design: 2027 wins roll the current roster forward, so one roster counts twice.
copy.score_basis: branch score = 100 + 10z of the served value across the 30 clubs (population sd); the Franchise Index is the weighted mean of the three branch scores re-standardised to 100 + 10z before any rank or letter is taken from it
copy.letter_note: letters follow rank across 30 clubs (storage._letter_grade); the score alone takes a tier colour
copy.farm_score_note: score re-standardised across 30 clubs; letter is the PROSPX letter
copy.outlook_note: a provisional projection (team_win_projections): projected 2027 wins from the current roster rolled forward; no interval is served for 2027, the 2026 win-total band lives under ODDS
copy.outlook_accounting: league sum pinned to 2430 wins; replacement 47.7 wins per club, derived from the 1000 WAR league benchmark in team_outlook_eval
copy.roster_note: Current roster as MLB's transaction feed lists it on 2026-10-02: a traded player's whole season counts for his new club, and rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.
copy.season_note: descriptive: the 2026 record is realized standing and carries no grade of its own
copy.cba_banner: Every 2027 figure is a 2022 CBA carry-forward: the agreement expires 2026-12-01 and no threshold, league minimum, arbitration structure or qualifying-offer value past it has been published.
copy.fin_cost_plus_note: descriptive index, not a model: projected 2027 WAR, less the 2027 WAR of the club's locked free agents, per $M of three parts printed beside it and never added into one payroll figure: guaranteed 2027 salaries (Spotrac's 2027 CBT payroll, or the club's own guaranteed contract AAV where that is larger), the platform's projected 2027 arbitration awards and the pre-arbitration minimum rungs. The index runs mostly as an inverse cost rank: Spearman 0.86 against minus the three parts together and 0.16 against projected WAR less the locked free agents across 30 clubs
copy.fin_cost_plus_registry: no registry row: Cost+ predicts nothing; a skill claim would need an eval first
copy.fin_no_ladder: a salary, a club surplus total and a cap-space cell never take a ladder; sign colour only
copy.surplus_ev: a sum of means (the Club Ledger's surNpv), never of quantiles
copy.tax_floor_note: Spotrac's 2027 tax payroll sits below the AAV of this club's own guaranteed 2027 contract rows (club and mutual option years left out), so the larger figure, the guaranteed AAV, stands in for it in the 2027 space, the 2027 CBT block, Cost+ and the $ per projected win and WAR; Spotrac's own figure prints beside it.
copy.mlb_leg_label: MLB surplus (MLB leg only, no farm)
copy.mlb_leg_note: the MLB leg is the Club Ledger's projected surplus of the club's contract and arbitration-path veterans; no prospect row is in it, so it never overlaps the FARM branch, and the Trade Machine currency, which does, is left to /ledger/ and /trademachine/
copy.cost_plus_numerator_label: Projected 2027 WAR less locked free agents
copy.cost_plus_parts_note: the three parts print apart and are never added into a payroll figure; a rung for a player whose 2027 salary is already a contract on file is left out of the arbitration parts, since the guaranteed part carries it
copy.market_fits_note: fit is a model of where a player signs, not of club quality (fa_team_fit provisional)
copy.market_realized_sentence: realized value, not skill: this is what the contracts returned, not how well the club chose them; the counterfactual, what the same dollars would have bought elsewhere that winter, is not observed, so no club is ranked by it
copy.market_realized_coverage: covered signings carry the realized block; the current winter carries none because no season has elapsed
copy.front_office_note: descriptive league-relative behavioural profiles; no forward claims (org_tendencies)
copy.zbar_note: z against the panel's league mean and sd; style, never a ladder
copy.promotion_timing_note: The rookie cutoff is 45 days before the final scheduled game (MLB glossary). A tag prints only where an org differs from the league after a 30-org test.
copy.dugout_sentence: Realized value, not skill. What is shown here is what happened after the club's decisions: the reliever called, the pinch hitter sent, the pinch runner sent, the intentional walk issued, the bunt laid down, and the run sent. Counterfactuals (the runner held, the starter left in) are unobserved, so no manager or club is ranked on decision quality. The running game's gate returned a bounded null: a club's decision value did not repeat between halves of its own season.
copy.dugout_agent: The agent is the club-season until the manager ledger lands; a club that changed managers during a season is one row here and two in reality.
copy.dugout_style: Style, not skill: each is a signed z-score across the thirty club-seasons of its season, sign as measured. Not an index, no ladder, no plus sign; a frequency has no good direction, and these repeat because they are policy.
copy.dugout_not_summed: per family, never a cross-family total; defensive subs carry a count only
copy.dugout_gate: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. The season-controlled split-half correlation of 0.1085 sits INSIDE its permutation null band [-0.1501, 0.1272], so per-agent decision value in the running game is not a repeatable property of the agent. The board may render and be sorted by attempt VOLUME, which is a style axis; the plus metric is WITHHELD, exactly as leverage_board does today.
copy.arb_tender_note: not a payroll forecast: assumes every player is tendered; a non-tender lowers the figure. Extensions are absent
copy.arb_flag_note: steps not from published service time
copy.arb_cost_sum: sum of the 2027 ladder steps incl. pre-arb minimums: the /arbitration/ Team View's 2027 arbitration and pre-arb min. columns added together
copy.arb_flag_key: flag bits: 1 step not from published service time, 2 step from the debut heuristic, 4 no salary on file, 8 past the CBA expiry, 16 2020 prorated
copy.ou_mkt: actual minus OUR model: what the arbitration system paid relative to comparable players. Sums to roughly zero by construction.
copy.ou_war: actual minus WAR (fWAR basis) priced at that season's dollars per win. Does NOT sum to zero, because arbitration systematically pays below the open market.
copy.never_combine: The two residuals measure different things and are never averaged or summed.
copy.park_source: Baseball Savant statcast-park-factors, rolling=2 for a venue the default view drops, and the default view's own row for a venue it carries on a short sample; batSide all
copy.park_short_note: clubs whose venue holds less than a full 3-season sample only; every row carries its PA sample and its window so a consumer can shrink it, and no consumer may treat it as a 3-season factor
copy.park_not_tiered: 100 = neutral; a hitter's park is not better, so nothing here takes a ladder
copy.park_attendance: attendance is not served in v1 (owner decision D11)
copy.history_note: standings 2000-2026 join by StatsAPI team id and need no spine; the bWAR line runs through franchise_spine.json
copy.history_pennants: pennants and titles are not on disk as a served field; only clinched and divisionChamp for the cached season
copy.bwar_basis: club bWAR by season, Baseball-Reference basis (war_daily), through the spine
copy.odds_interval: Intervals are Monte Carlo error only: how far the number moves if the simulation is re-run. Error in the talent estimate underneath it is much larger and not measured here.
copy.odds_no_market: No futures price has been captured, so there is no book number, edge column, value flag or expected return.
copy.odds_ledger: no market captured; ledger has 21 entries, 0 resolved
copy.odds_win_total_basis: The win band is schedule noise at a fixed talent estimate: no talent uncertainty, in-season drift, injuries or trades. It is narrower than a real forecast interval by an unmeasured amount.
copy.odds_as_of: As of the end of the regular season (2026-10-04): postseason results are not in these odds.
copy.board_lede: Every club on the Franchise Index; a club code opens its page.
copy.board_foot: Index and branch scores are 100 + 10z across the 30 clubs and take the z ladder; every other column prints on its own scale, plain.
copy.board_playoff_title: Playoff: the season simulator (playoff_odds_sim provisional); after the regular season it reads the settled outcome.
copy.tree_hidden: Hide the tree; show only the root card
copy.tree_full: The full three-column tree with every leaf
copy.canopy_eyebrow: Franchise Report Card . Composite Grade Tree
copy.odds_bracket_line: Pennant and World Series: implied by the postseason bracket simulator as of 2026-10-02, no market.
copy.odds_division_as_of: As of the end of the regular season (2026-10-02): postseason results are not in the Division, Playoffs, Bye, Proj W and Win band columns.

history_hof.rule: A Hall of Famer is credited to one franchise: the one with which he accumulated the most Baseball-Reference WAR, summed over every stint in the daily WAR file, batting and pitching together. Ties go to more seasons with the franchise, then the earlier first season.

registry_verdicts.surface: The displayed WAR site-wide from the 2026-09-03 epoch, by owner answer EPOCH-Q4: war_source DISPLAY_PROVIDER 'ewar_v2' (data/ewar.json) feeds the career_war display view (career totals, per-season lines, current-season pills, WAR sorts). It also feeds the direct display readers: MLB player cards (war_bwar beside the served number where it differs), the WAR/PA+ and WAR/IP+ boards, PAL, the Earned WAR board and the trade lookup. It was the facade default until the 2026-10-03 fWAR label epoch, when the training label readers (eFV labels, anchors, WAG, farm MLB production, surplus, the projections and the FA corpus, the arbitration WAR spine) moved to row fwar

accountability.score_formula: 100 + 10 * (v - mean) / population sd over the 30 served values, one decimal; None stays None
accountability.index_formula: weighted mean of the three graded branch scores, re-standardised by the same formula

what_this_page_does_not_claim: a forecast: the Franchise Index is a descriptive rank of realized standing plus one provisional projection, re-standardised across 30 clubs
revenue, operating income or a franchise valuation: no source in the tree carries them
attendance before 2026, ticket prices, local or national TV money, revenue-sharing status: not sourced
minor-league payroll, front-office salaries, actual CBT bills paid: not sourced
pennants and titles as a served field: only clinched and divisionChamp for the cached season
the cap a Hall of Fame plaque shows: the HISTORY tile credits each inductee to the franchise where he accumulated the most bWAR (hof_export's frozen rule), by playing WAR, whatever the plaque's role
a per-game MLB park index over a home slate: the per-club park factor table is what is served (fa_meta.park_factors)
defensive shifts, manager identity, any per-club decision-quality grade or manager skill claim
a combined arbitration residual: ou_mkt and ou_war are two tiles and never one number
a club payroll forecast: FIN is descriptive and quotes the Club Ledger, which serves none
